title: Well Done
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：well　|　正文 321 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 well 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Well, in 1956 the grandmother knew the lamp at the window, and everybody in the courtyard said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: before the February rains the grandmother had ② well known the lamp, and nobody had asked a single question. The grandmother had come to the courtyard two years earlier, and spoke little of the courtyard he had left behind him.

The diary for February 1950 puts it plainer. The lamp was ③ well worth, and the child who kept it had ④ well kept it twice before the winter came; nothing in the courtyard was ever done well in those days. The child wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant something else. He knew the lamp ⑤ better than anybody else in the courtyard, and of all who knew it that year he knew it ⑥ the best of all of them. He was not a man who explained himself, and the courtyard had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1963 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the diary. What the line asked for was that the lamp be kept ⑦ well every year, and that whoever did it be ⑧ well careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done well.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1966 she knew the lamp ⑨ well year after year when nobody else would, and ⑩ Well, she said in 1968, that was the part the courtyard never forgot; the diary still speaks well of it. She kept the lamp in the same window for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the courtyard never forgot how well it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 好（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had well known …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 好（修饰形容词：well worth）
C. adv. 充分地（评注性状语，置于句首：Well, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 充分地（修饰过去分词：had well kept it）
E. adv. 好（比较级 better than：拿叔叔跟院子里其他人相比）
F. adv. 好（最高级 the best of all of them：那个年头所有人之中的比较）
G. adv. 充分地（被动结构中的中位状语：be kept well）
H. adv. 充分地（修饰形容词：be well careful about the whole business）

answers.why: well 意为“好”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Well, in 1956 …。
well 意为“好”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had well known the lamp。
well 意为“好”，此处修饰形容词 worth（值得）：was well worth。
well 意为“充分地”，此处修饰过去分词 kept：had well kept it twice。
well 意为“好”，拿叔叔跟院子里所有人相比，故用比较级 better than。
well 意为“好”，那个年头里所有人当中他做得最甚，故用最高级 the best of all of them。
well 意为“充分地”，被动结构 be kept well 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
well 意为“充分地”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be well careful about the whole business。
well 意为“好”，1966 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次了解那件小小的灯，副词置于动词之后。
well 意为“充分地”，母亲 1968 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Well, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年，祖母充分地在窗边了解那件小小的灯；院子里人人都说那是头一回。（Well, …）
雨季到来之前，祖母已经好了解那件小小的灯。（had well known …）
那件小小的灯当时好值得。（well worth）
保管它的那位孩子在入冬前已经充分地把它守着过两回。（had well kept it）
叔叔做这件事比院子里任何人都来得好。（better than …）
在那个年头里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最好。（the best of all of them）
answers: Well, in 1956 the grandmother knew the lamp at the window.
Before the February rains the grandmother had well known the lamp.
The child who kept it had well kept it twice before the winter came.
He knew the lamp better than anybody else in the courtyard.
Of all who did it that year, he did it the best of all of them.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 well 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Well, in 1956 the grandmother knew the lamp, and nobody forgot it.
Before the February rains the grandmother had well known the lamp.
The lamp was well worth, or so the diary says.
The child had well kept it twice before the winter came.
My mother knew the lamp well year after year when nobody else would.
Well, the courtyard never forgot that part of the story.
